lines.en: I have been set on the field's centre line.
Once the frame lands, it does not move.
Someone turned me to a new angle.
The ring faces down the line.
I tilted, and someone straightened me.

lines.zh: 底座在土里又深了一指。
lines.en: The base sank another finger into the soil.
The wind passed through the ring and sounded.
I have been moved in closer.
My slanted shadow slowly rights itself.
The nails have been hammered tight again.
I stopped among three wooden frames.
Snow lands on my face and melts.
A red ring is painted at my centre.
I have been shot at hundreds of times.
The arrow holes are neatly spaced.
The wood has drunk in the impacts.
I stand between two trees.
There are no other targets nearby.
A target does not feed.
A spider web has formed on my upper corner.
There is nothing behind me.
I do not glow, and I make no sound.
The sun drags my shadow off slant.
I wait for an arrow.
The wind sets my rim humming.
I face the shooting mark.
Your position is right.
Your hands are not steady enough.
Whoever shoots must plant their feet.
You are aiming dead centre.
The arrow does not hurt me.
You have no bow.
Do not hack wood with a sword.
You aimed right.
This ring is narrower than your shoulders.
The red ring faces your arrow.
You have not drawn yet.
One arrow at a time.
The frame jolted.
The face dented in a ring.
Wood does not know pain.
A new hole beside the old ones.
I stayed nailed where I was.
Soil welled out from the base.
That arrow drove deep.
Another flake of paint came off.
I am still standing.
The rim is humming.
A target does not live on food.
You set that down on the shooting line.
Take it away, it blocks the view.
Wood knows nothing of food.
This wood tastes nothing.
Put it back in your pack.
Do not trade it for my ring.
Save the rations for the archer.
Put it somewhere else.
Shoot your arrows.
You knocked me half an inch crooked.
The wood gave a muffled knock.
Crooked, I still do not fall.
The nails went deeper.
Someone set me straight.
The soil is pushed out by my base.
Your shoulder must smart.
I took that knock.
I am back on the centre line.
Knock into it again.
The one beside me is a shield.
Arrows come to me. Blows go to it.
Three frames in a row.
Targets do not answer each other.
Someone lines us up.
Our rings face the same way.
Old targets get replaced.
We are all nailed to the ground.
Do not knock it crooked.
You may shoot.
No hands grow in this ring.
I am nailed down and cannot rise.
An arrow fell in the dirt before me.
It lies askew by my base.
I cannot reach it.
The wind flipped it over.
Stoop and pick it up.
I am nailed down and cannot move.
Is that my job.
Find someone else.
The bowstring sounded.
The red ring faces your arrowhead.
I wait for the arrow to stick.
Your sight is a finger too high.
I am nailed firm.
Wood does not dodge.
This one will sound.
The wind leans left.
This target is free.
Loose the arrow.
I will not fall.
I wait for this one.
I stay on the shooting mark.
Your elbow is too high.
Your string is not fully drawn.
The ring does not stir.
You took another arrow.
The frame has not swayed.
Fletching brushed the ring's edge.
You are steadying your breathing.
This one should find the mark.
I haven't shifted an inch.
Your wrist has levelled.
Shooting from farther opens it up.
The arrow sticks with a dull thud.
A fresh hole in the ring's rim.
An arrow strikes and I hum once.
That arrow went wide.
Dead in the red ring.
The second followed.
The wood split a hair.
I am still on the centre line.
Your hand grows steadier.
Another arrow.
This hole is deep.
The target is not ruined.
A target stands before the shooting mark.
The red ring is newly painted.
The frame bites into the ground.
It blocks a corner of the open field.
The face looks due east.
The arrow holes still show their age.
It has been set on the centre line.
The wind comes from behind it.
Wood shavings lie at its foot.
There is one more target here.
It begins waiting for arrows.
Come and shoot.
Fire charred half my face.
I toppled off the stand.
Swollen wood cannot stand.
The blast spun me round.
This is exactly what I am for.
This light went through the red ring.
Wood cannot starve.
Lightning split the frame.
There is no ground to nail into.
